jobs.name: medicine-cell-atlas
jobs.prompt:

Canvas is a 3-column by 2-row grid of six invisible equal 512x512 cells, total 1536x1024, NO visible grid or labels. Genuine transparent background. Every sprite must fit fully INSIDE its own cell with at least 30 pixels transparent padding; sprites never touch each other.
TOP LEFT cell: the large ivory/lilac immune cell from the source, isolated WITHOUT the two teal microbes. Preserve its beautiful broad soft lobes, cream highlights, lavender/pink shaped shadows, C-shaped right-facing opening and major silhouette. Draw its missing inside surface cleanly. Center it, diameter roughly430 pixels. Make it exactly the same cell design, no eyes or faces, no noisy texture.
TOP MIDDLE: one large clean red blood cell in three-quarter view, like the source top-left red disc. Red/coral flat shaped planes, indented center, slightly tilted oval. Roughly330x240 pixels.
TOP RIGHT: one side/edge-on red blood cell, a tilted narrow red oval with a thin dark berry plane, roughly330x150 pixels.
BOTTOM LEFT: a single small teal microbe matching one of the source microbes: short round-oval capsule with a few rounded protrusions, dark teal/jade shadow planes, no face. Roughly260x220 pixels.
BOTTOM MIDDLE: a second slightly different teal microbe in the same design, slightly longer oval, roughly270x200 pixels.
BOTTOM RIGHT: a red blood cell at a different three-quarter tilt, roughly330x250 pixels.
Retain the approved clean sophisticated 2D illustrated color planes. No granular texture, glossy 3D materials, outlines, atmosphere, backdrop, shadows beyond the object silhouettes, props, human, lab objects, letters or checkerboard. The only image content is these six beautifully drawn separate source-matched sprites.
